svg.aria-label: Umbra Unit Frames — the Forever theme
svg.title: Umbra Unit Frames — the Forever theme
svg.text: /UUF THEME
The Forever theme
On WoW: Forever the frames take on the client's own look, and Auto picks it there; every other client
keeps Umbra's slate and teal. The same frames twice, as the modern set stacks them. The theme repaints
the interface around a unit — the plates, the text and the cast bar, now amber — and adds a bronze rim
one physical pixel wide along the top, right and bottom of each frame body. The class edge, the names,
health, absorbs and resources keep their colors: a theme never changes the unit.
Umbra
/uuf theme umbra · auto everywhere else
Forever
/uuf theme forever · auto on WoW: Forever
The rim, enlarged 12 times
1 physical pixel = 0.76 units at 1.3125 pixels per unit
The left is the class edge's
The top and bottom lines start
where the portrait begins; the
class edge and the gap beside it
keep their whole height.
The right owns both corners
A step darker than the top, as if
lit from the top left. It runs the
full height and the other two stop
short of it.
Inside, on the last pixel
The lines lie on the body itself,
so the cast bar below keeps its 2
unit gap and the edges stay flush.
The cast bar and the aura icons
get none; the bottom line runs
over the level plate.
